decisions.reason: The click-in adapter is a system accessory for the firm's DUOLARE track. It stays useful as long as the track system is sold, so it is unlikely to be discontinued soon.
LED luminaires in premium lighting often run for four to five years, but this 2018 model is approaching the age when collections get refreshed.
Home automation hardware ages quickly, so replacement is a real risk. Installed customers still need support and continuity, which favours keeping it for now.
A luminaire family with its own page is likely a core collection item that is typically sold over several years.
